candidate_discovery: Per changed memory: existing jieba FTS top 64, shared about IDs (including both empty), same world, similarity = max(character bigram Dice, SequenceMatcher). True dependency pairs use dependency review only.
conflicts: All structurally incompatible related pairs with similarity >= 0.20 are checked for conflicts, identically for all methods. Judgments finish before any merge; unresolved incident pairs block merges.
merge_exclusions: latest actual body revision is manual
both event times known and different
incompatible normalized quantities with same units
model_decision: One shared source-grounded pair prompt; never receives labels. Merge keeps the existing semantically fuller memory, earlier on ties; length/time preference is a non-binding suggestion. No synthesized merge body. The model can refuse any candidate.
selection: Each method runs the full frozen corpus twice. Worst mismerge rate (zero merges is infeasible), worst recognition, largest calls and worst case P95 are used. Feasible <= 0.05; recognition within < 0.03 of maximum ties; fewer calls, lower P95, then frozen order. Double independent scoring with AND on positive fields. Any degradation invalidates a run.
